resources.string: Open Lovelies to check your updates.
This policy has not been configured for this build. Contact support from Help Center.
A browser could not open this policy. Please try again when a browser is available.
%1$s processed. Review matched people before sharing.
Preview paused. This screen uses sample progress.
Lovelies is for people aged 13 or older. Choose your age range before using the camera or selecting photos.
Choose your age range to continue.
Check your age and guardian permission status before continuing.
Lovelies is not available to people under 13. No selfies or photos are needed. You can still get help or request deletion.
A parent or guardian must request each purpose and complete an independent review before you can continue.
Face sign-in is allowed by your current age and guardian permissions. Other purposes need their own approval and your consent.
Use the request reference and revision provided by the young person. You must use your own registered adult account. An independent reviewer checks adulthood and parental responsibility.
Show this reference and revision to your parent or guardian. They use their own account to request an independent review. No invitation message is sent.
I am this person’s parent or legal guardian
This request alone enables no camera or photo access. Each approved purpose still needs the young person’s own consent. A guardian cannot see their photos through this process.
This stops the approved purposes and retires affected photo access. Later approval does not restore old consent or sharing permissions.
A saved permission change has an unconfirmed result. Check status or retry that exact saved change before submitting another.
We could not verify the permission response. The camera and photo selection remain unavailable. Check status or get help.
Permission details changed. Check status before submitting again. An age change from a minor account needs independent review.
This request is unavailable to your account. Check the exact reference or ask the young person for a current request.
A current guardian request already exists. Check its status before creating another.
A separate registered adult and an independent reviewer are required. A checkbox or request reference cannot approve permission.
Your saved guardian request is still linked to this account. Check its current status; you can withdraw permission even if your own product access is restricted.
Your original export request has an unconfirmed result. Check that saved request; a new request will not replace it.
The saved request conflicts with the server receipt. Keep this request and get help before making another change.
Guardian withdrawal is saved, but completion is not confirmed. Check status or retry the same saved withdrawal. Other permission changes will not replace it.
Lovelies is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
